en: Isha Kriya
15-minute guided meditation

Isha Kriya is a powerful 15-minute guided meditation for health and well-being. Through this practice you will learn to use your breath, thought, and awareness in a way that greatly enhances your ability to use your mind and body.
Miracle of Mind
7-minute guided meditation

A powerful guided meditation designed by Sadhguru. It takes only 7 minutes a day. With clear step-by-step instructions and gentle bells, this practice establishes a solid foundation for mental well-being. Perfect for beginners and daily practice.
Nada Yoga
The yoga of inner sound

Nada Yoga is the science of using sound and vibration to transcend the limits of being. Sound is not just a means of communication, it is a bridge to the infinite. Through AUM chanting and deep listening of the inner sound, this practice takes you beyond mental noise toward inner peace.
Yoga Namaskar
10-minute morning routine

Yoga Namaskar is a complete 10-minute sequence to stretch and strengthen the back. This powerful morning practice activates the lumbar region of the spine and strengthens the muscles along it. Ideal for beginners, it can be done at home, at the office, or in the park.
Nadi Shuddhi
Cleansing of the energy channels

Nadi Shuddhi is a simple yet powerful 5-minute practice that cleanses the nadis, the channels through which pranic energy flows. This practice results in a balanced system and psychological well-being. Guided by Sadhguru.
Chit Shakti for Health
Free guided meditation

Chit Shakti is a powerful guided meditation that uses the power of the mind to create your reality. This practice is designed for health and well-being. Through affirmations and guided visualization by Sadhguru, activate the healing energy within you.
Chit Shakti for Love
Free guided meditation

Chit Shakti is a powerful guided meditation that uses the power of the mind to create your reality. This practice is designed to open your heart to love in all its forms. Guided by Sadhguru, it uses affirmations and visualization to cultivate love and compassion.
I am not the Body — Neither am I the Mind
7 minutes to remember your true nature

A deep meditation based on advaita teaching. By affirming "I am not the Body" on the inhale and "Neither am I the Mind" on the exhale, you transcend limiting identifications and awaken to your true essence.
Yoga for Success
5 minutes
A short yoga practice guided by Sadhguru to activate the energy of success in your system. In just 5 minutes, align your body and mind to attract prosperity and achievements.
Yoga for Back Pain
10 minutes
A 10-minute practice guided by Sadhguru to relieve back pain. Stretch and strengthen your spine with gentle, mindful movements.
Explore Your Inner Self
5 minutes
A 5-minute guided meditation to explore your inner world. Sadhguru takes you into the depths of your being on this introspective journey.
Isha Upa Yoga
Guided practices
A collection of guided Isha Upa Yoga practices with Sadhguru. These powerful routines are designed to activate the joints, rejuvenate the system, and bring health and well-being to your life.
